response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web software engineer (15+ years) with strong breadth in TypeScript, Node.js, D, and distributed backend services, but the role requires deep hardware-oriented expertise in SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator architecture, GPU/SIMD-MIMD workload analysis, and hardware-software co-design. None of these appear in the resume; the closest adjacent experience is low-latency service optimization at Sociomantic, C/C++ work at National Instruments, and some robotics tooling at Altom, which is far from silicon performance architecture. Education is a BS in Computer Science with sufficient years of experience to meet the formal bar, but the domain mismatch is fundamental and not bridgeable through a short ramp at principal level.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software engineering experience across web, mobile, desktop, and embedded
Some low-level/systems exposure: C/C++ at National Instruments, low-latency async services in D
Strong engineering discipline (TDD, CI/CD) plus open-source, teaching, and conference-speaking track record
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, RTL, or hardware architecture experience whatsoever
No deep-learning training/inference optimization, GPU, or AI accelerator workload analysis
Career trajectory is application/full-stack focused, not principal-level silicon performance architecture

key_factors.factor: Missing SoC/IP modeling and hardware co-design expertise
No AI accelerator / DNN workload optimization background
Extensive general software engineering and systems performance experience
